Nigerian-born goalkeeper Kingdom Osayi has made an impressive start to his international career with Uganda, stepping in for veteran Denis Onyango and subsequently earning his first start for the Cranes during the November international break, PUNCH Sports Extra reports. The 22-year-old made his senior international debut on October 5, 2026, in a 1-1 friendly draw against DR Congo before making his competitive debut in Saturday’s 1-1 draw against Botswana in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. Osayi replaced Onyango in the 41st minute after the experienced goalkeeper sustained an injury and produced several important saves after the break to help Uganda secure a point. He was handed his first start on Tuesday in another 1-1 draw against Botswana in Gaborone, completing an encouraging international break with two appearances. “Not the result we wanted. We keep getting better. Glad to have made my first start. Thank God for a successful international break and also maintaining the top spot in the 2027 AFCON qualifiers,” Osayi wrote on X. Morocco matches Nigeria’s No.5 best FIFA rankings AFCON qualification non-negotiable – Awoniyi Chelle charges Eagles for back-to-back Tanzania victories Although born and raised in Nigeria, the goalkeeper qualifies to represent Uganda through his maternal grandmother, who was born in Kaberamaido, according to the Ugandan football authorities. He accepted an invitation from the Federation of Uganda Football Associations in September 2026. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Before switching international allegiance, Osayi developed his career in Nigeria, featuring prominently for MFM FC, where he spent three years between 2019 and 2022. He rose to prominence at Doma United during the 2023/2024 Nigeria Premier Football League season, keeping 15 clean sheets in 29 appearances. He also went 540 minutes without conceding a goal, earned Player of the Month recognition and attracted calls for a Super Eagles invitation. Osayi joined Rangers International in 2024 before moving to Swedish club Assyriska FF in 2025.
